info.title: Memory Router OpenClaw Compatibility Surface

get.summary: Get memory count time series for the resolved bank

parameters.description: Timestamp column to bucket on. `created_at` (default) = ingest time; `mentioned_at` / `occurred_start` = event time, useful for migrated corpora where ingest time is a single point and doesn't reflect the underlying knowledge timeline. Unknown values fall back to `created_at`.
parameters.name: time_field

schema.description: Timestamp column to bucket on. `created_at` (default) = ingest time; `mentioned_at` / `occurred_start` = event time, useful for migrated corpora where ingest time is a single point and doesn't reflect the underlying knowledge timeline. Unknown values fall back to `created_at`.

200.description: Hindsight-compatible response forwarded through Memory Router

BankId.name: bank_id
BankId.description: Memory Router writer ID; resolved to the configured write bank.

BadRequest.description: Malformed path, JSON, body, or route-specific request

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid router bearer token

NotFound.description: Unknown writer or sanitized upstream not-found response

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request exceeds the router body or route-specific bound

ValidationOrBlocked.description: Request blocked by router policy or rejected by Hindsight validation

RateLimited.description: Router retain/recall quota or upstream client rate limit exceeded

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the router quota window resets, when supplied

UpstreamClientError.description: Any other sanitized upstream Hindsight 4xx response with its original status

ScanUnavailable.description: Router response safety scanner worker failed, is busy, or exceeded its field/time limits

UpstreamFailure.description: Hindsight unavailable, redirected, unauthorized, invalid, oversized, unsafe, or failed

UpstreamTimeout.description: Hindsight did not respond before the configured timeout
